featured_reviews.name: Murtaza Shikari
featured_reviews.review_text:
I used Farohar Tours and Travels during my recent visit to Bombay, India for multiple airport pickups and drop off services as well as full day intercity cab services and they provided exceptional service every single time.

They were easy to get in touch with (over WhatsApp/calls) to make the required reservations. They were super responsive and were able to accommodate requests even the day before the intended journey which I really appreciated. And they have very well maintained cars and provide sedans and suvs depending on number of passengers and bags you are traveling with.

The experience for the pickup from the airport was great since they have the ability to park in the vip/employee lot so you are able to exit the international airport much faster than the rest of the crowd. And I was able to find them based on the precise location and guidance that was communicated over the phone. They were also very punctual on the pickups , arriving several minutes early in some cases.

I got to have Chirag on all of my airport pickups and drop offs and the service and support was top notch and enjoyed the conversations during the rides. He was super punctual and the communication upto the pickup and drop off was excellent, with timely updates.

I also used the intercity cab services for a full day round trip to Poona and the driver was very good , excellent road etiquette and drove at a safe  speed and was very well acquainted getting in and out of the city. And very try trustworthy.

My entire family (and extended) have been using their services and I highly recommend them on your next visit to India.

featured_reviews.name: Na'ama Attar
featured_reviews.review_text: Our family has used their airport transfer services to multiple occasions. The cars provided are in excellent condition, clean and comfortable. Importantly, they are always on time, often early for pickups. The owner Danesh is friendly, responsive and accommodating to all requests. The chauffeurs are polite, communicative and helpful with luggage. We appreciate the thoughtful little touches- mineral water bottles on the car seat, tissue boxes and good music!

featured_reviews.name: Finhas Jhaveri
featured_reviews.review_text:
Farohar tours and Danesh (the owner) provided excellent service for us while we were in Mumbai. We used them on multiple occasions - pick up and drop off to the airport, and transport to another city. The cars and drivers were very courteous and professional. And they took care of our needs and even helped with the bags so that we did not have to pick them all up.
They were always on time and made sure we arrived promptly at our destinations.
All the costs were shared with us before had so we knew exactly what we were going to be charged. So there were no surprises.
I would definitely recommend using Farohar Tours for exceptional and reliable car transport services in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Urvaksh Khambatta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Thank you very much for such a pleasant and memorable experience. The driver arrived on time, was in uniform and the car was sanitized and clean.

To my suprise ,I found a bottle of water or coca cola in the car since I was travelling over 300 kms out of Mumbai.

The driver has excellent driving skills and is open to suggestions and values his clients deeply. He demonstrated good behaviour and was ethical as well. The owner followed up for any suggestions and wanted to check for feedback.

I highly recommend that you ride through this company and you won't be disappointed. This company is high on value for money and is extremely satisfying.

featured_reviews.name: mabel verghese
featured_reviews.review_text: I was highly impressed with the way Danesh was handling the business.Very professional. We were travelling to Mahabaleshwar which is almost 5 hrs drive from Mumbai. The chauffeur reached exactly on time as was decided and he drove the car so well. I was worried as I had my old mother along with me.  But the chauffeur as per the Guidance of Danesh halted the vehicle at good places to eat and use the restroom.  The chauffeur was also knew the place so well we didn’t need any tour guide. He drove us all around Mahabaleshwar and Panchgani . Got us the best strawberries direct from the farm.Overall a very relaxed and enjoyable holiday. Thanks to Danesh and Sachin. Without a second thought  I would always prefer to rent a car from Danesh. Do try you get much more value for money

featured_reviews.name: Pushkar Karande
featured_reviews.review_text: I happened to hire a car for an outstation drive from Mumbai to Nashik for my mother and wanted someone with safe driving skills and a descent vehicle to drive her to and back on the same day. A friend of mine referred me to contact Mr. Danesh from this travel agency, to whom I explained my concern, where he assured me that every aspect of cleanliness, drive quality and comfort will be taken care and he delivered everything exactly as he promised. I would definitely priorities them for our next trip.

We returned with an abundance of cherished reminiscences rather than mere photographs. Without the slightest hesitation, our next voyage shall unequivocally be with Gem Tours & Travels.

featured_reviews.name: Sandy Patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our experience with Gem Tours was nothing short of exceptional! From start to finish, their service and staff were truly amazing. Every single member of the team was kind, helpful, and incredibly welcoming – it felt like we were traveling with family.

They were there for us every step of the way, ensuring we were comfortable, informed, and enjoying every moment. We explored the best parts of South Africa, from breathtaking landscapes to vibrant cities, all while gaining a deeper appreciation for the rich culture of Africa thanks to the insightful explanations and stories shared by our guides.
The safari locations were beyond magical – we were lucky to witness an incredible variety of wildlife up close, making memories that will last a lifetime. A special shoutout to the chef Prabhu, whose delicious, hearty meals warmed us every single day.
Every member of the staff – from the driver (Oz) to the support crew (Nashit and Fenil) who were with us throughout – went above and beyond to ensure we had a seamless and unforgettable journey.

I wholeheartedly recommend Gem Tours to anyone looking for a personalized, enriching, and unforgettable African adventure. Thank you, Gem Tours, for making this trip so special!

featured_reviews.name: Alexandra Charlton
featured_reviews.review_text: Amish gave us the most incredible, personalised tour around Bombay with stops to taste incredible local street food (and the best chai!!), and visits to some of the most incredible and iconic locations, tailored for where we had and hadn't already been. The experience of a true local, which as a tourist you could never have from tourist guides alone. Amish's love, passion and pride in the city was something you couldn't help but share within the first hour and by the end of the tour, had become a city to remember and love for life! Thanks so much Amish - chai five 🖐🏼🙏🏽

featured_reviews.name: Katie Hamilton
featured_reviews.review_text: I cannot recommend this company enough! We booked the tour for the elephanta caves the night before, and Amish was very kind and accommodating. He really wanted to make sure I had the best experience of Mumbai! And I did! My tour guide for the elephanta caves was AK, and he was amazing! He was so smart, and since he was a native to the island, I was able to experience the caves and a little bit of the island itself. He answered all my questions and I learned so much! I went alone on this tour and Amish and AK made me feel safe the entire time. Also, I was on a cruise and pickup and drop off from the green gate was very easy! Honestly it was a day I will remember forever! BEST TOUR EVER!

featured_reviews.name: Nil Durak
featured_reviews.review_text: Uniquely Bombay! Imagine an evening motorcycle tour where you get to see it all; gorgeous architecture transformed into breathtakingly lit-up wonders, like a Christmas tree. I thoroughly enjoyed my few hours with Amish, even though it was a busy day with Modi and Macron visiting the city. He makes every step and experience a surprise, sharing stories of neighborhoods and the history of colonial-era buildings. The breeze on your face as you buzz through the boulevards and roads of iMumbai creates real excitement. Especially if you have limited time in Mumbai, this tour is perfect for you. Plus, it includes a delicious vegetarian meal ☺️

featured_reviews.name: Alan Woodward
featured_reviews.review_text:
NOT TO BE MISSED!!!
Our first trip to Mumbai and we couldn’t have asked for a better introduction than with Amish. We had a wonderful “behind the scenes” personalised tour of the real Bombay - Amish’s enthusiasm, detailed knowledge and obvious love for his city is infectious. We came away with a shared love for this amazing city.
Book Mumbai Moments, you won’t be disappointed.
Alan & Angela

featured_reviews.name: Brettly777 Brettly777
featured_reviews.review_text: After many years of coming to Mumbai, this was my first tour and it opened up a whole new experience of this incredible city. Amish was a brilliant guide. The tour was timed perfectly. We especially loved the Dhobi Ghat. Highly recommended. 👍🏼❤️

featured_reviews.name: Stefano Maruge Fernando
featured_reviews.review_text:
Fantastic experience. Amish was able to organize the whole excursion at very short notice. Considering the full service (pick-up, ferry, tickets to the caves, water bottles, private guide, drop-off) I paid a very good price, definitely lower than  the market prices for the same tour.

The driver came to pick me up sharp at the agreed time, and we shoot off to visit the majestic caves.

Avi was my guide: very knowledgeable and kind. It really felt like an exclusive experience and you are looked after the whole time.

Amish is a very kind individual an I met  him after the trip where he even offered me a tasty chai and gave me a wonderful gift to conclude my trip.

Im looking forward to my next organized tour with Mumbai Moments and I could not recommend them enough.

featured_reviews.name: Ann C
featured_reviews.review_text:
Would highly recommend Mumbai Moments. Mr. Amish Sheth is so knowledgeable and welcoming, and his love for Bombay makes the tour special. It was wonderful to get a mix of the classic sights as well as hidden gems of everyday life. A terrific experience no matter if you’re new to the city or not. We learned a lot about the history, culture, and people and made many happy memories!

Super amazing fantastic!

featured_reviews.name: Evan
featured_reviews.review_text: This review is long overdue. I can not speak more highly of my experience with Mumbai Moments. I received the right balance of cultural and historical education in a perfectly tailored way to what I was looking for in my visit to India. I felt I was being taken behind the scenes and shown India in a way I couldn’t imagine. My guide was friendly, professional and deeply knowledgeable. He was extremely flexible in how and what he showed me from the markets to the historical sites. I would never consider another guide and felt so fortunate to have been recommended to Mumbai Moments!

featured_reviews.name: sagar surve
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a terrible experience with this agency. I wanted to apply for a South Korea visa, and I had all the required documents. I visited their office for document verification, but they told me that my NOC was not valid. When I asked for the reason, they said that since my company’s head office is in Bangalore, I should apply from Bangalore and not from Mumbai.

I explained to them that I work for an MNC whose headquarters are in Bangalore, but the company has several offices across the country, including one in Mumbai. I live and work in Mumbai, and all my documents, including my passport, are registered in Mumbai. So it made no sense for me to apply from Bangalore.

It seemed like they did not have proper knowledge about the process, and they were not supportive at all. Unfortunately, the person I was interacting with was the owner of the company.

Later, I handled the process myself and contacted the embassy to confirm the same question. They informed me that my documents were completely correct and that I had been given the wrong information by the agency. I proceeded with the application on my own and successfully obtained my visa.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Mr. Sagar,

Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear that your experience was not satisfactory.

We would like to clarify that visa application processes can sometimes involve varying interpretations, especially in cases involving employment across multiple locations and elegibility to apply visa as per jurisdiction. We / our team provide guidance based on standard practices and previous case experiences to minimize the risk of application complications or demands raised by consulate in similar cases.

That said, we respect that applicants may receive direct clarification from the consulate, as their approach when dealing directly with applicants may differ from that followed through travel agencies. We are pleased that your application was successfully processed.

We value your feedback and will continue to refine our advisory approach to better serve our clients.

And then Multiple entry visa.

featured_reviews.name: Garema Srivastav
featured_reviews.review_text:
Unprofessional is the only thing that comes to my mind. We are an NRI family wanting to apply for South Korean visa. We have to apply for Visa in India because as NRIs who have not completed 2 years of residency in the present foreign country of residence, have to apply for South Korean visa in the home country i.e. India.

I reached out to them to understand the documents. They bluntly told me that we cannot apply from India since all our documents are from Cambodia (where we currently live but have not completed 2 years yet).

Despite sending them the link of the Korean consulate website specifically stating the above rule for NRIs they refused to acknowledge that any such rule exists and that we have to apply on Cambodia. I also informed them that we have visited Korean Embassy in Cambodia and they told us to apply in India due the 2 year residency rule. Hana travels refused to accept it. Their "seniors" know better.

Hana travels also told me that in any case my husband's passport is issued in Uttar Pradesh. So they cannot take his application because it doesn't come under their "jurisdiction" and my husband will have to apply from Delhi. To which i asked them you can take my application as my passport is issued in Mumbai and my permanent address is also from Mumbai. To which they tell me that no, my birthplace is Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh so they cannot take my application as well. Very confused, I asked them what happens to my son's application since he was born in Seoul, South Korea and his passport was also issued in Seoul. They never answered that question. With their logic, i need to take his passport to Seoul to apply for visa for South Korea. An agency who specifically does South Korean visashas zero knowledge about how this works.

When i asked them to please connect with the consulate and clarify because i am 100% sure i cannot apply in Cambodia and i need to apply in India. They said they have consulted their "seniors" and yet again, their seniors know better. Hana travels sent me a link of the consulate website and asked me to contact them myself. A simple phone call also was too much for them to do because too arrogant to admit they have no idea what i am talking about.

I emailed the consulate, and i got a response withing minutes that i need to apply in India. I have shared the screenshot for the "learned seniors" information. No reply to that as well.

The attitude with which Hana travels spoke to me when they themselves were unaware of the rule was rather amusing. An honest hardworking agency would take it upon themselves to find out about a rule if it's come to their attention for the first time. Rather than trying to make me look dumb and do the research they are supposed to do.

I will obviously not be using their service again. And would advice you not to either. Because their lack of experience and commitment to providing basic service will get your visa rejected.

Edit 1-
If you only had taken the same amount of time as you took to write this response in finding out what needs to be done in our case, you would be professional. We have engaged another agency who will be finding everything out  for us rather than giving us a standard response that they have limitations and restrictions and jurisdictions and that you can't do it. My problem is not that you don't know what to do. It's that you dont even bother to find out. That is unprofessional. Without even understanding my case you told me that i cannot apply in India. It was me who had to get confirmation that i need to apply from India. So please dont try to mask your unprofessionalism.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Madam,

Thank you for your detailed explanation regarding your current situation. We truly understand the challenges you are facing.

While we acknowledge that you may be eligible to apply for your visa from India, as per the guidance received from the Consulate, please note that visa applications within India are subject to regional jurisdiction. In order to apply under the Mumbai jurisdiction, all supporting documents must strictly comply with the prescribed checklist and format provided by the Consulate General of the Republic of Korea. 

As an intermediary authorized only to submit visa applications on behalf of applicants, we are not empowered to accept or approve documents that deviate from the official requirements. The final decision regarding the acceptance of such documents rests solely with the Consulate.

We hope this clarifies the limitations we face in accommodating exceptional cases in the absence of documents required to establish eligibility under the Mumbai jurisdiction. We also understand that the principal applicant, your husband, falls under the Delhi jurisdiction due to the passport issuance location, which further affects the eligibility to apply through Mumbai.

We are here to help in case if consulate can throw some light regarding solution for your case. Thank you for your understanding.       

With best regards,
Management Team 
Hana Travels LLP
